subject: Re: EoQ priority check — Solstice AI / Redwood inference pilot
messages:
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: alex@solstice.ai, priya@solstice.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, Jun 24, 2026 15:12 -0700
Subject: Solstice AI — recap & proposed next steps (Redwood pilot)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum into the quarter-close: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: in-product assistant for developer docs + code generation guidance (latency target < 300ms for first token, 99th pct SLA).
- Target scale: 5k monthly active users initially, expect 25k in 12 months.
- Data requirements: VPC/private deployment preferred for PII-free logs and SOC 2 evidence.
- Key stakeholders: Alex (Product), Priya (Infra), CFO signoff for budget.

Proposed Redwood pilot (30 days) 
- Dedicated pool (2x A10G equivalent) for a 30-day performance and cost baseline
- Pilot deliverables: latency & cost dashboard, sample integration guide, and an initial SLO runbook
- Estimated committed spend: ~$18k for the month (can present a trimmed config if budget constrained)

Open questions / asks
1) Is the CFO likely to approve a pilot commit before EoQ (Jun 30)? If not, what is the expected approval timing?
2) Any additional security docs you need aside from the SOC 2 report we shared?

Next steps
- I can send a short SOW + deck (attached) and a 30-minute follow-up to finalize pilot config. Proposed times: Thu Jun 25 (10–11am PT) or Mon Jun 29 (2–3pm PT).

Attachments: Solstice-Redwood-Deck.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Thanks — happy to adjust based on budget/timing.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com

Cc: priya@solstice.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Jun 30, 2026 09:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice AI — quick EoQ check on pilot approval

Alex — circling back as we head into EoQ. Did you get a chance to share the SOW and numbers with your CFO? Given your latency/throughput constraints we want to hold the pilot capacity in our pool for early July if approval comes through. 

If timelines slipped, totally understandable — quick favors: can you let me know if budget has been pushed to next quarter or if there are any remaining blockers I can help resolve (security evidence, PO process, pricing)?

If it's helpful I can pull a one-page pricing summary and a trimmed pilot option (1x A10G equivalent, ~$9k) to present to the finance owner.

Appreciate any update — thanks!

—Aditya

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Jun 30, 2026 15:03 -0700

Alex — quick bump before EoQ closes. If getting CFO approval this week is unlikely, please say so — we can prep a revised pilot for July. No pressure, just trying to understand priority so we can align capacity and discounts correctly.

If I don’t hear back today I’ll assume you’ve moved to next quarter and follow up week-of-July-6 to rebook.

Thanks —Aditya
From: Alex Chen <alex@solstice.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: priya@solstice.ai
Date: Wed, Jun 30, 2026 18:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice AI — final EoQ bump (can we confirm priority?)

Aditya — thanks for the follow ups and sorry for the slow reply. Short update from our side: 

- We ran your deck past finance this morning. CFO is supportive of the use case but we will not get a signed PO before June 30 — budget cycle stretched, approvals pushed into early July.
- Security team asked one follow-up: can you provide a short note on data retention controls for private deployments? (We saw the SOC 2 but they want the specifics for VPC logging and retention windows.)
- We're still interested in the pilot and would prefer the trimmed option you mentioned if that simplifies approval.

Can we schedule 30 minutes next week (Mon Jul 6 or Tue Jul 7) to confirm the trimmed pilot and share the SOW? Priya — looping you for infra details.

Thanks,
Alex
Product Lead | Solstice AI
